intent: An L-shaped bracket joining two panels at a right angle: a flat base leg and a vertical upright leg of equal thickness meeting at a sharp internal corner. Printed as one part, base leg flat on the bed.

parts.part_notes: Load is bending at the corner; gusset optional.

engineering_rationale.load_path: screw load on the upright transfers as bending into the internal corner, per part_notes
engineering_rationale.check: corner_wall_mm = 6 mm >= 4 mm min for a 90-degree bend joint under bending load (PLA)
